name: B10-0160/2025 (PPE) – The need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to help Syria rebuild after the fall of Bashar al-Assad's regime. It asks for continued humanitarian aid, a gradual lifting of sanctions that block aid and reconstruction, and support for justice for past crimes. It also urges Syria's interim government to be inclusive, protect minorities and women, and hold free dialogue. The text is a set of requests and opinions; it does not itself change any law.

- The EU is asked to keep funding aid and ease some sanctions on Syria.
- Syrians, Syria's interim government and EU businesses are affected.
- Next, EU institutions and member states decide whether to act on these requests.
